description: This Java source file defines the AttractionListActivity class for an Android application, which manages the main user interface screen displaying a list of tourist attractions. The class handles permissions, fragment lifecycle, options menu actions, and interactions with external services related to location updates and testing functionalities.

classes.name: AttractionListActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of tourist attractions, manages location permissions, and provides menu actions to trigger test notifications and toggles for geofence functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, checks for location permission, and loads the main fragment.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Requests location updates when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggering test services or toggling features.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of location permission requests.

methods.name: requestFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Initiates permission request for fine location access.

methods.name: fineLocationPermissionGranted
methods.description: Handles actions after fine location permission is granted, such as adding geofences and requesting location.

methods.name: showPermissionSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a snackbar explaining the need for location permission and offering to request it.

methods.name: showDebugDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog box with debug information based on the provided title and message resource IDs.
